tools.name: tefacturo_get_status
tools.description: Get the three states of one issued document: SUNAT answer (estadoSunat), declaration (estadoComprobante) and mail delivery (estadoEntrega), with the declaration text. Use it before a document is sent again. Read-only.

tools.name: tefacturo_get_xml
tools.description: Get the signed UBL XML of one issued document. The reply holds xmlFirma, the XML in base64, and hashCode (may be null). Read-only.

tools.name: tefacturo_get_pdf
tools.description: Get the printed PDF of one issued document, as a base64 string (decode it to a .pdf file). Read-only.

tools.name: tefacturo_get_cdr
tools.description: Get the SUNAT receipt (CDR) of one document as a base64 ZIP that holds an XML answer from SUNAT. The CDR proves SUNAT accepted the document. Read-only.

tools.name: tefacturo_preview_document
tools.description: Render a PDF preview of a document from its JSON, without a number and without a SUNAT filing (the tool sets datosDocumento.numero to 0). Use it to check the layout before tefacturo_emit_invoice. Read-only. Returns base64Pdf.

tools.name: tefacturo_emit_invoice
tools.description: SUNAT FILING, IRREVERSIBLE: files a new invoice (factura, type 01) with SUNAT for this login's RUC. The numero must be new: check the series with tefacturo_get_status first. Use tefacturo_preview_document to check the layout first. Use the same JSON as the tefacturo docs for this document (close2u,

tools.name: tefacturo_emit_receipt
tools.description: SUNAT FILING, IRREVERSIBLE: files a new receipt (boleta de venta, type 03) for a consumer with SUNAT, through the daily summary. The numero must be new: check the series with tefacturo_get_status first. Use the same JSON as the tefacturo docs for this document (close2u, datosDocumento, detalleDocume

tools.name: tefacturo_emit_credit_note
tools.description: SUNAT FILING, IRREVERSIBLE: files a credit note (nota de crédito, type 07) that adjusts an earlier invoice or receipt. The payload must name the original document in comprobanteAjustado and a motivo. Use the same JSON as the tefacturo docs for this document (close2u, datosDocumento, detalleDocumento

tools.name: tefacturo_emit_debit_note
tools.description: SUNAT FILING, IRREVERSIBLE: files a debit note (nota de débito, type 08) that adds a charge to an earlier invoice or receipt. The payload must name the original document in comprobanteAjustado and a motivo. Use the same JSON as the tefacturo docs for this document (close2u, datosDocumento, detalleDo

tools.name: tefacturo_void_documents
tools.description: SUNAT FILING, IRREVERSIBLE: sends a voiding summary (resumen de baja) that cancels issued invoices or receipts. The payload holds fechaGeneracion, fechaDocumentoBaja and resumenBajaItemList (serie, numero, tipoComprobante 01 or 03, motivo). SUNAT processes it later: check it with tefacturo_get_statu
